builds to take advantage of caching in our build process this is a sample multi-stage Docker file for a node pnpm project again you can find this link and full guide for this Docker file below but what I want to show you is how a third stage can be used to cach dependencies in this example we'll start with a common base image node 20 in this

often are we going to be changing our dependencies by separating out our dependencies into a separate stage we can take advantage of doctor's caching mechanisms to only rebuild this stage when there are changes to our package files without this typically every time we made any change to our project and went to rebuild the docker image we

would also be rerunning the pnpm install every time even if the dependencies haven't changed you'll notice we're also using a special Mount flag here this is is a special feature we'll go into in another video but it's essentially am mountable volume where you can store your cash and reuse it between build stages now we'll have a build stage very
